'''Kenneth Silva''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd at [[2000 California State Championship]] on 15 April 2000, according to Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d540">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-16-california-state-championshipsd540/ california-state-championships], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 16 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-16-california-state-championshipsd540/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
